text_block_list.text:
After returning from Hokkaido...
To make up for the time off,
I created a special training regimen for the final stretch.

"It was quite a high-load workout,
but Buena Vista stayed focused and gave it her all.
As a result—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!!
Circuit training is... finished...!
choice_data_list: Alright, that's the whole menu done!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!
All done~~...!
choice_data_list: Good work. Was it tough on you?
Good work. Was that tough?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Super tired! I didn't think
I could do that last burpee jump~...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in exchange... I can really feel my growth.
Thanks for restructuring the routine!"
choice_data_list: (…Good, she doesn't seem too tense)
（……Thank goodness, she doesn't seem tense.）

text_block_list.text:
It seems we've managed to completely clear away
all the "excitement" of those around her
that Buena Vista had taken into her heart.
choice_data_list: Now all that's left is to give it everything we've got at the Shuka Sho.
Now all that's left is to give it everything we've got at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
But... will it be okay?
choice_data_list: What?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I took in all of everyone's excitement to the absolute fullest.
And that ended up working against me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: If the same thing happens again...
choice_data_list: If that happens, I'll just think of something else

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "think about it"?
choice_data_list: Kyoto Racecourse has that big pond, right?
Kyoto Racecourse has a big pond, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Yeah...
It's inside the dirt course.
choice_data_list: Maybe just float around on a swim ring...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
I wonder, maybe a different approach would be better...
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'll think of everything, so don't worry.
Yeah. I'll figure something out, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Leave it to me and focus on the race.
Leave it to me and focus on the race.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Taking you up on your offer...
I'll lean on you for a bit, okay?

Having completed a summer training camp that fulfilled both body and mind,
Buena Vista returned to Tracen Academy.
Waiting there for her was—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san, welcome back!
How was summer training camp?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming to meet me!
Fufu, as you can see, everything went great!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I can see how fulfilled you feel just by looking at your face!
Now then, regarding your next race—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
You're still aiming for the final crown,
the Shuka Sho, right?
In other words—the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is off the table?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
!
Ah—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, it's just that the public had such high expectations...!

True, I had heard those voices.
With Tiara Umamusume making waves worldwide these days,
it's only natural that expectations for Buena Vista are high.

Conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the long-cherished
dream of the Japanese racing world—if achieved, it would
surely be a breathtaking view. However—
choice_data_list: We won't be entering this year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista will run the Triple Tiara all the way to the end.
That was our decided goal from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
So it's true, then...
Some fans are bound to be disappointed.
Do you have a message for them?
choice_data_list: Buena will show you all a breathtaking view at the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Right before everyone's eyes, I shall live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see. When it comes to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
it really does feel like a faraway place, huh.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. The showdown with Desire-san will only get fiercer... I'm really looking forward to the Shuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...If I were extraordinarily strong...
would there have been a path for me to go to the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'?"
choice_data_list: Buena...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's not that I'm regretting it
or hesitating, you know?
It's the path we decided on together, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't help wondering if that kind of future could've happened too.
Just 'what ifs', I suppose.
choice_data_list: That's not your dream, though. Is it?
That's not your dream, though. Is it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. My dream is to create
a breathtaking view that reaches everyone."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I understand.
I just want to be close to everyone—"
choice_data_list: Let's turn the Shuka Sho into a breathtaking spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then... What should I do next, I wonder...
Training befitting a saint—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Why don't you take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here?
Could it be... you've come to train as well, Cafe-san?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No. I have been
waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Muscle tension, a shadow in your eyes.
You seem to have pushed yourself quite hard at the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: An ordinary person would have ruined their body by now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Yes, if it were an ordinary person... that would be true.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"However...
I am, after all, the chosen one."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If it's me, I can train harder than anyone else.
I can grow stronger. I can shine...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am—special!
I will become the person worthy of myself.
Therefore... something like this is no hardship at all."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's just who you are, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, how about we try a different location next time?
If it's training at the academy, I can also...
give my input to some degree."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...!
...Will you bestow your teachings upon me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...I believe I understand very well what it feels like to chase after something unseen."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Please... pull me up with you.

Whose dream will bear fruit—
The Shuka Sho is right around the corner.
